description: Executable Candidate recipe of NVIDIA's DGX Spark playbook (nemotron) for Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B-A3B BF16: lmsysorg/sglang:dev-cu13-nemotronh-nano-omni-reasoning-v3 as named by the Nemotron Omni model card, pinned by arm64 digest, serving the exact model revision through sglang.launch_server with the playbook's flags. The adapter image pins librosa 0.11.0 with a hash-locked Python 3.12 ARM64 wheel closure for offline audio requests. Resource envelopes are estimates from the playbook's --mem-fraction-static, not measurements; physical Spark acceptance is pending.
title: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B-A3B BF16 SGLang single Spark (NVIDIA playbook)
